name: plan_date_night
description: Create a three-stop date plan or Qloo-grounded discovery shortlist that balances two sets of public cultural tastes. Does not book anything. Live mode sends the selected cultural entity IDs and city to Qloo; sensitive traits and private personal information are not accepted.
outputNotes: mode and source identify data provenance
warnings explain unverified or fictional fields
cost is null for live recommendations
scores are application indices, not probabilities or personal-trait inferences
